notes: Two independent official sources agree: apollohospitals.com (a dedicated Hyderabad cardiologist profile plus a corporate cardiology profile) and apollo247.com. Matched facts: name (distinctive initial-prefixed form 'E Sanjeeva Kumar'), specialty (Cardiology / interventional cardiology), hospital and unit (Apollo Health City, Jubilee Hills) and city — four of the required signals, so no risk of confusion with another doctor. Experience figure is inconsistent across the index (17 years vs 26 years vs 13 years on lower-quality directories); the input's '17+ Years' is supported, and the DM Cardiology from NIMS plus MD in 2001 make ~17-25 years plausible — recorded as found and flagged rather than picking one. Deliberately omitted: a switchboard-style number (04069321004) surfaced in a search summary without a clear official page behind it, and Apollo's hospital-level number is added automatically by the pipeline, so it was not recorded here. Skedoc carries a 'Dr. Sanjeev Kumar E' Hyderabad cardiologist page — likely the same man under a variant spelling, but not certain, so it was left out rather than merged.
